meaning.en: A nearly vertical cavity in a glacier through which meltwater from the surface drops into tunnels that are within or beneath the ice.
meaning.vi: Một khoang gần như thẳng đứng trong sông băng, qua đó nước tan chảy từ bề mặt chảy xuống các đường hầm bên trong hoặc bên dưới lớp băng.

meaning.en: A nearly vertical hole in a glacier down which flows a stream of water melted from the surface.
meaning.vi: Một lỗ gần như thẳng đứng trên sông băng chảy xuống dòng nước tan chảy từ bề mặt.

meaning.en: (geology) A cylindrical, vertical shaft that extends through a glacier and is carved by meltwater from the glacier's surface.
meaning.vi: (địa chất) Một hình trụ, trục thẳng đứng kéo dài qua sông băng và được chạm khắc bởi nước tan chảy từ bề mặt sông băng.

sentences.en: In a cottage in the environs of Paris called Le Moulin joli, there sat at the same table an old man engraving and an old woman whom he called his meuniere also engraving.
sentences.vi: Trong một ngôi nhà nhỏ ở ngoại ô Paris tên là Le Moulin joli, ngồi cùng bàn với một ông già đang khắc và một bà già mà ông gọi là meuniere của mình cũng đang khắc.

sentences.en: Gohier and Moulin, on refusing to retire, were placed under a military guard; and General Moreau showed his political incapacity by discharging this duty, for the benefit of Bonaparte.

sentences.en: Of the Château du Coudray, which is separated by a moat from the Château du Milieu, the chief remains are the Tour du Moulin (Tothce.ntury) and two less ancient towers.

sentences.en: Considerable excitement therefore was created both in England and France by the "find" of bones at Moulin Quignon, and a commission of inquiry was appointed.

sentences.en: Jurieu defended the doctrines of Protestantism with great ability against the attacks of Antoine Arnauld, Pierre Nicole and Bossuet, but was equally ready to enter into dispute with his fellow Protestant divines (with Louis Du Moulin and Claude Payon, for instance) when their opinions differed from his own even on minor matters.
